text: Nina L: Quick mini-review of the small 'create policy' form in the console. We're seeing users miss required fields on mobile. Proposal: keep compact layout but make required state explicit for narrow screens and avoid showing inline errors until blur or submit. Thoughts? Owen H: Sounds good. My only pushback: if we delay inline errors, the top summary must be very clear and keyboard-focus reliable. Also, for destructive actions in the same form ("Remove policy"), do we want typed-confirm or a simpler checkbox? Priya S: Accessibility first: asterisk + sr-only text + aria-required on inputs. For mobile show "Required" text in labels rather than just an asterisk. For destructive: typed-confirm for irreversible deletes, checkbox + confirm for reversible actions. Nina L: Proposed rules: 1) Show inline error on blur and then while editing; 2) On submit with errors show a compact banner: "We couldn't save — 2 fields need attention" and move focus to first invalid input with a small 120ms transition; 3) Permanent remove = typed-confirm exact policy name; reversible remove = inline snackbar with undo. Owen H: Example markup to include in the spec: ```html ``` Also add aria-live="polite" for the banner. DesignBot: prototype lint: found 1 input missing aria-required in /design/prototypes/policy-create. Also flagged insufficient contrast on banner CTA. Priya S: :thumbsup: on the pattern. Small copy tweak: banner -> "We couldn't save — please fix the highlighted fields." Keeps it user-focused. Owen H: :thumbsup: Ill add the aria-live region and the focus animation helper. I'll open a PR with code snippets and microcopy options. Nina L: Thanks — I'll add the typed-confirm wording and mobile label variant to the Figma notes and include a short a11y checklist. DesignBot: PR #512 created with updated spec, accessibility checklist, and prototype fixes.
